name: Trickery Domain
desc: Trickery Domain: a cleric subclass. Hand-written summary, not the book text.

features.name: Blessing of the Trickster
features.desc: Touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour. One creature at a time.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
features.desc: Make an illusory copy of yourself for 1 minute. You can cast spells from its space, and you have advantage on attacks when you and it both threaten a target.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
features.desc: Become invisible until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Divine Strike
features.desc: Once per turn, add extra poison damage to a weapon hit (1d8, more at level 14).

features.name: Improved Duplicity
features.desc: You can make up to four copies of yourself.
